notes.title: Oasis Update out now
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34267950/7c157fe9bdc297e9749989aa59d639362d100590.png

Here it is: The update 1.1.0 of AIRA VR! 

New Content

The new "Oasis" map is now available and playable in a new freeplay mode.
Defend against 7 attack-waves with your favorite towers and weapons, available from the beginning. Master the Oasis map to recieve a new achievement and to permanently unlock the new Gauss Tower. This new Tower has physical projectiles and is especially effective against the Skilith Ray Deflect, which is immune to the laser weapons. 

Visual Improvements

We have polished and reworked many things, from all towers to some weapons. Mostly all levels providing a substantive upgrade in both mood and ambience. In the future we want to improve these aspects even further.

SteamVR Input

From now on we're supporting the latest SteamVR input system, which allows us to use the full potential and support all SteamVR HMDs including the new Valve Index. Now you can customize your controlls for all compatible devices. In the "SteamVR Settings" - "Controller Binding" you can select "AIRA VR" to adjust it. Furthermore, the inputs feel more precise, all buttons and feedback systems can be used.

Performance and Bugs

We were able to increase the performance at Level 7 and fixed some minor bugs.


We hope you enjoy our Oasis Update and please let us know, if you encounter any kind of issue.
Cheers,

notes.title: AIRA VR | Version 1.0.1 released!
notes.content:
Here it is: The first update of AIRA VR! This time we focused on fixing some minor issues and improved a bunch of small details.

Optimizations:

The button to skip the intro sequence is now available from the start. This way you are able to defend the galaxy more quickly.
As desired in some reviews, we slightly increased the difficulty in level 1 and 2.


Finally, we called the pest control to eradicate some bugs, did some vacuum cleaning to liberate the command ship of star dust and fed the aliens.

We wish you continue to have lots of fun on your interstellar journeys!
